title: 着装要求与个人卫生
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/020_着装要求与个人卫生.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/020_着装要求与个人卫生/src.py

points.K8: 不吃不喝，不吸烟不化妆
points.K9: 食品不进实验室，实验冰箱不放食物
points.K12: 戴着手套不碰公共物品
points.K13: 实验服和手套不出实验室

shots.scene: 欣欣穿着扣好的实验服、束着头发，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a buttoned lab coat, long trousers and closed-toe shoes waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲着装要求与个人卫生。

shots.scene: 实验室门口，一面穿衣镜，旁边洗手池
shots.prompt_en: At a laboratory entrance, a full-length mirror stands beside a hand-washing sink. No people.
shots.narration: 穿对、洗净，是最基本的防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着实验服，坐在办公室工位上喝水
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, still wearing his lab coat, sits at an office desk drinking from a cup.
shots.narration: 阿杰穿着实验服，回办公室喝水。

shots.scene: 小研看见了，皱起眉头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks in, sees him and frowns.
shots.narration: 小研说：你把实验室带到这儿了。

shots.scene: 实验服袖口的小污点放大，旁边桌面、水杯
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a small stain on the lab coat sleeve, next to the desk surface and a drinking cup. No faces.
shots.narration: 袖口沾的东西，会落到桌上、杯上。

shots.scene: 阿杰愣住，看看自己的袖子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student freezes and looks at his own sleeve.
shots.narration: 阿杰愣住：这也会污染？

shots.scene: 试管外壁挂着一滴液体，手套握住试管
shots.prompt_en: A single drop clings to the outside of a test tube held by a gloved hand. No faces.
shots.narration: 一滴挂在试管外的液体。

shots.scene: 手套依次碰到笔、门把手、手机，各处留下小点
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand touches a pen, a door handle and a phone in turn, each leaving a small colored dot. No faces.
shots.narration: 经手套，传到你摸过的每样东西。

shots.scene: 小点从手上到嘴边，还落进培养皿
shots.prompt_en: Colored dots travel from a hand to a mouth icon, and also drop into a sample dish. No people.
shots.narration: 可能进了嘴，也可能毁了样品。

shots.scene: 危害扩散到同事和办公室的示意
shots.prompt_en: Colored dots spread from a lab bench to a coworker pictogram and an office desk icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不加控制，伤到的可能是同事。

shots.scene: 化学品滴落在裸露手臂上的图标，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a chemical drop falling on a bare forearm, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品碰到皮肤，就可能受伤。

shots.scene: 长袖衣服和短袖衣服对比，长袖打勾
shots.prompt_en: A long-sleeved shirt with a green check next to a short-sleeved shirt with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 衣物尽量遮住皮肤，长袖好于短袖。

shots.scene: 棉质衣物打勾，化纤衣物旁有火焰和熔化图标
shots.prompt_en: A cotton shirt with a green check, and a synthetic shirt with flame and melting icons. No people.
shots.narration: 化纤遇火易燃易熔，棉质更好。

shots.scene: 背心、露腰装被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A tank top and a crop top crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 背心、露腰装，不能进实验室。

shots.scene: 短裤和凉鞋、拖鞋被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Shorts, sandals and slippers crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 短裤、裙子、凉鞋拖鞋都不行。

shots.scene: 液滴落在包脚鞋面上被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A liquid drop falls onto a closed-toe shoe with a solid upper and is stopped. No people.
shots.narration: 鞋要包住脚面，挡住洒落的液体。

shots.scene: 裤腿盖在鞋面外，旁边塞进鞋里的被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Trouser legs worn over the shoes with a green check; trousers tucked into shoes with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 裤腿盖住鞋面，别塞进鞋里。

shots.scene: 工程实训车间门口，学生穿安全鞋
shots.prompt_en: At the door of an engineering workshop, students put on safety shoes and long trousers.
shots.narration: 车间等场所，按要求穿安全鞋。

shots.scene: 小研把长发扎起、盘好
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties her long hair back into a bun.
shots.narration: 长头发一定要扎起来。

shots.scene: 散发靠近火焰、垂向烧瓶，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Loose hair near a burner flame and dangling toward a flask, crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 散发会着火，还会垂进烧瓶。

shots.scene: 宽大袖口、围巾、挂绳靠近转轮，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A wide sleeve, a scarf and a lanyard hang near a rotating wheel, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 宽袖、围巾、挂绳，会卷进转动部件。

shots.scene: 袖口收紧，围巾挂绳摘下放好
shots.prompt_en: A sleeve cuff fastened snugly, a scarf and a lanyard taken off and put away. No faces.
shots.narration: 袖口收紧，下垂的东西都摘掉。

shots.scene: 戒指、手链、手表放进储物盒
shots.prompt_en: A ring, a bracelet and a watch are placed into a small storage box. No faces.
shots.narration: 进实验室前，先摘下首饰。

shots.scene: 戒指戳破手套的特写，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A ring pokes a hole in a glove, crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 戒指会戳破手套，还会藏污纳垢。

shots.scene: 金属手链靠近带电接线柱，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A metal bracelet near an electrical terminal, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电学实验，摘下金属饰品，擦干手。

shots.scene: 口罩边缘与胡须间的缝隙示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a gap between a tight-fitting mask edge and a beard. No real people.
shots.narration: 戴密合口罩，胡须要刮干净。

shots.scene: 【实拍】对镜自查：扣好实验服、束发、长裤、包脚鞋（全身镜前固定机位，人物不露脸）
shots.prompt_en: In front of a mirror, a person buttons a lab coat, checks tied-back hair, long trousers and closed-toe shoes.
shots.narration: 进门前，对着清单查一遍。

shots.scene: 护目镜和手套图标，旁边写字板
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety goggles and gloves next to a blank clipboard. No people.
shots.narration: 护目镜、手套，按风险评估来戴。

shots.scene: 框架眼镜打勾
shots.prompt_en: A pair of prescription glasses with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 近视的同学，戴框架眼镜。

shots.scene: 丝袜和裙子被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Stockings and a skirt crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 裙子、丝袜也不适合实验室。

shots.scene: 背包、外套挂进门外储物柜
shots.prompt_en: A backpack and a coat are hung in a locker outside the laboratory door. No faces.
shots.narration: 背包外套，留在门外储物柜。

shots.scene: 手机放在试剂瓶旁，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A phone lying next to reagent bottles on a bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手机别放在实验台上。

shots.scene: 手机和计算器装进透明密封袋
shots.prompt_en: A phone and a calculator are sealed inside a clear plastic bag. No faces.
shots.narration: 必须带进去的，装进密封袋。

shots.scene: 包进了污染区，打上污染圆点
shots.prompt_en: A bag inside a contaminated area gets covered with colored dots. No people.
shots.narration: 带进去容易，干净带出来就难了。

shots.section_title: 不吃不喝，不吸烟不化妆
shots.scene: 零食、饮料、口香糖图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of snacks, a drink and chewing gum, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，不吃不喝不嚼口香糖。
overlay: 不吃不喝，不吸烟不化妆

shots.section_title: 不吃不喝，不吸烟不化妆
shots.scene: 香烟和化妆品图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cigarette and cosmetics, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 严禁吸烟，也不化妆。

shots.section_title: 不吃不喝，不吸烟不化妆
shots.scene: 水杯和烧杯放在一起，箭头表示拿错
shots.prompt_en: A drinking cup and a beaker stand side by side, an arrow shows them being mixed up. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品会沾进食物，杯子会拿错。

shots.section_title: 不吃不喝，不吸烟不化妆
shots.scene: 手到嘴的路径示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a path from a hand to a mouth, with a hazard drop on it. No people.
shots.narration: 一吃一喝，有害物就进了嘴。

shots.section_title: 食品不进实验室，实验冰箱不放食物
shots.scene: 实验室门口，食物和饮料被挡在门外
shots.prompt_en: Food and drinks are stopped at a laboratory door by a no-food sign. No people.
shots.narration: 食物饮料，不带进实验室。
overlay: 食品不进实验室，实验冰箱不放食物

shots.section_title: 食品不进实验室，实验冰箱不放食物
shots.scene: 实验冰箱里只有试剂，饭盒被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory refrigerator holds only reagent bottles; a lunch box is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验冰箱只放实验材料，不放饭菜。

shots.section_title: 食品不进实验室，实验冰箱不放食物
shots.scene: 实验用胡萝卜和食用油贴上标签
shots.prompt_en: A carrot and a bottle of cooking oil used for an experiment get blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 实验用的食品，标明仅供实验，不能吃。

shots.section_title: 食品不进实验室，实验冰箱不放食物
shots.scene: 烧杯盛饭被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Rice served in a beaker, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不用实验器皿，盛食物、喝水。

shots.scene: 实验室水龙头和纯水桶，旁边禁止饮用图标
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory tap and a pure water container, with a not-drinking-water icon. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室龙头的水和纯水，都不能喝。

shots.scene: 饮水机在实验区外的休息区
shots.prompt_en: A drinking water dispenser in a rest area outside the lab. No people.
shots.narration: 喝水，到实验区外的饮用水处。

shots.scene: 在实验水槽里洗饭盒水杯，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Washing a lunch box and a drinking cup in a laboratory sink, crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 不在实验水槽洗杯子餐具。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手伸向脸，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand reaching toward a face, crossed out with a red X. No real faces.
shots.narration: 污染会从手跑到脸上、嘴边。

shots.scene: 揉眼、挠鼻子的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of rubbing eyes and scratching a nose, crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 别揉眼、挠鼻子，管住小动作。

shots.scene: 隐形眼镜盒图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A contact lens case icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不在实验室里摘戴隐形眼镜。

shots.section_title: 戴着手套不碰公共物品
shots.scene: 戴手套的手握门把手，门把手留下污点
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand grips a door handle, leaving a colored spot on it. No faces.
shots.narration: 戴着手套，不碰门把手。
overlay: 戴着手套不碰公共物品

shots.section_title: 戴着手套不碰公共物品
shots.scene: 电梯按钮、键盘、电话被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An elevator button, a keyboard and a telephone with red X marks over gloved hands. No people.
shots.narration: 电梯按钮、键盘、电话也不碰。

shots.section_title: 戴着手套不碰公共物品
shots.scene: 下一个人徒手握同一个门把手
shots.prompt_en: Another bare hand later grips the same stained door handle. No faces.
shots.narration: 你碰过，下一个人就沾上了。

shots.section_title: 戴着手套不碰公共物品
shots.scene: 用过的手套投入危险废物桶
shots.prompt_en: Used gloves are dropped into a hazardous waste bin. No faces.
shots.narration: 沾了化学品的手套，按危废处理。

shots.section_title: 实验服和手套不出实验室
shots.scene: 实验服和手套挂在门内挂钩，门外是走廊
shots.prompt_en: A lab coat and gloves hang on a hook just inside the lab door; a corridor is outside. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服和手套，不穿出实验室。
overlay: 实验服和手套不出实验室

shots.section_title: 实验服和手套不出实验室
shots.scene: 办公室、会议室、食堂三个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an office, a meeting room and a canteen, each with a lab coat crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 办公室、会议室、食堂都不能穿。

shots.section_title: 实验服和手套不出实验室
shots.scene: 阿杰回到实验室门口脱下实验服挂好
shots.prompt_en: The young male student returns to the lab door, takes off his lab coat and hangs it up.
shots.narration: 阿杰回去，脱下实验服挂好。

shots.section_title: 实验服和手套不出实验室
shots.scene: 校园和社区的图标被一个盾牌护住
shots.prompt_en: A campus and a neighborhood icon protected by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 管好自己，也是保护身边的人。

shots.scene: 台面一侧放污染物托盘，另一侧放干净物品
shots.prompt_en: A bench divided into two zones: a tray of used items on one side, clean items on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 污染的和干净的，绝不混放。

shots.scene: 实验记录本和笔放在干净区
shots.prompt_en: A lab notebook and pen kept on a clean shelf away from the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 记录本放在干净、溅不到的地方。

shots.scene: 戴脏手套写记录被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A dirty gloved hand writing in a notebook, crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 别戴着脏手套写记录。

shots.scene: 本子被带去食堂，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lab notebook carried to a canteen table, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验用的本子和笔，留在实验室。

shots.scene: 小研用完加热搅拌器后擦拭清洁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes down a hotplate stirrer after use.
shots.narration: 设备用完，当天清洁去污。

shots.scene: 共用设备上的残留混进下一个人的实验
shots.prompt_en: Residue on a shared instrument drops into the next user's flask. No people.
shots.narration: 共用设备的残留，会混进别人的实验。

shots.scene: 实验前后检查台面，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A bench checked before, during and after work, with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 实验前中后，都查一查台面。

shots.scene: 两个人形图标，一前一后，中间握手
shots.prompt_en: Two person pictograms, one finishing and one arriving, shake hands at a clean bench. No people.
shots.narration: 体谅前一个人，照顾下一个人。

shots.scene: 摘手套后走向洗手池
shots.prompt_en: After taking off gloves, hands move toward a sink. No faces.
shots.narration: 摘下手套，马上洗手。

shots.scene: 接触微生物、离开实验室、吃饭前三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a microbe, an exit door and a meal, each with a hand-washing symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 接触样品后、离开前、吃饭前都要洗。

shots.scene: 手套破了，换新手套
shots.prompt_en: A torn glove is replaced with a new one. No faces.
shots.narration: 手套破了或沾污了，及时更换。

shots.scene: 戴着手套洗不等于洗手，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand under a tap, crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 戴了手套，摘下后照样要洗手。

shots.scene: 【实拍】打湿双手，取洗手液（洗手池旁固定机位，手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands are wetted under running water and liquid soap is applied.
shots.narration: 流水打湿，取洗手液。

shots.scene: 【实拍】掌心、手背、指缝依次揉搓（手部特写，动作连贯）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands rub palm to palm, the backs of the hands, and between the fingers.
shots.narration: 掌心、手背、指缝都要搓到。

shots.scene: 【实拍】搓指尖、拇指和手腕后冲净（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: fingertips, thumbs and wrists are rubbed, then rinsed under running water.
shots.narration: 指尖、拇指、手腕，再冲干净。

shots.scene: 【实拍】用一次性纸巾擦干，用纸巾关水龙头（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands are dried with a paper towel, and the towel is used to turn off the tap.
shots.narration: 纸巾擦干，用纸巾关龙头。

shots.scene: 阿杰摘手套洗手，走向休息区
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes off gloves, washes his hands and walks toward a rest area.
shots.narration: 休息时，先脱手套、洗手。

shots.scene: 休息区里喝水、拉伸
shots.prompt_en: In a rest area outside the lab, the young male student drinks water and stretches.
shots.narration: 喝水、拉伸，都到实验区外。

shots.scene: 手指上贴防水敷料，再戴手套
shots.prompt_en: A waterproof bandage is put on a cut finger, then a glove is put on over it. No faces.
shots.narration: 手上有伤口，用防水敷料包好。

shots.scene: 小研向老周说明，老周点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shows her bandaged hand to the older man, who nods.
shots.narration: 告诉负责人，必要时换个工作。

shots.scene: 五个图标依次亮起：试剂瓶、实验服、通风柜
shots.prompt_en: Five icons light up one by one: a reagent bottle, a lab coat and a fume hood first. No people.
shots.narration: 防污染：知物质、穿防护、用通风柜。

shots.scene: 第四、五个图标亮起：整洁台面、细心的手
shots.prompt_en: The fourth and fifth icons light up: a tidy bench and a careful hand. No people.
shots.narration: 保持整洁，小心工作，不想当然。

shots.scene: 实验服挂在实验室门内指定挂钩
shots.prompt_en: Lab coats hang on designated hooks inside the lab door, away from personal clothes. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服挂在实验室指定位置。

shots.scene: 实验服装进背包带回宿舍，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lab coat stuffed into a backpack to take to a dormitory, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不和日常衣物混放，不带回宿舍洗。

shots.scene: 被污染的实验服装袋，交实验室处理
shots.prompt_en: A contaminated lab coat is sealed in a bag and handed to the lab for treatment. No faces.
shots.narration: 沾污了，按本校规定统一处理。

shots.scene: 着装清单图标依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Checklist icons get green checks: tied hair, buttoned coat, long trousers, closed shoes, no jewelry. No people.
shots.narration: 穿对衣、扎好发、摘首饰、包住脚。

shots.scene: 禁止饮食、手套不出门、洗手三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons get green checks: no food, gloves stay inside, hand washing. No people.
shots.narration: 不吃喝、不带出、勤洗手。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一顶安全帽和一双安全鞋，挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a safety helmet and a pair of safety shoes and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲个人防护装备的选择。
